# HitroTech OrderScan

> AI-powered telecom order screenshot extractor. Upload batches of order screenshots, extract structured data with OCR, detect duplicates, and export to Excel.

HitroTech OrderScan helps telecom operators turn screenshots of customer orders into clean, structured data. It supports major Pakistan networks (Jazz, Zong, Ufone, Telenor, Onic, SCOM) and streamlines order management with duplicate detection and reporting.
